decisions: Stored private research vault (skill/, analysis/, data/, old BUILD_STATE.json, AGENT_PROMPT) in Cloudflare Workers KV namespace 'storyforge-vault' (contact sheets chunked into <= 4.5 MB zips under KV's 25 MiB per-value limit).
Built web frontend + backend API as Cloudflare Pages + Pages Functions in web/ (single origin, no CORS issues, KV binding + Worker secrets).

Resumed actual existing repository and deployed Pages site, rather than overwriting previous implementation or rewriting already-clean history again.

Background downloads have already hit the specified stop condition; preserve the exact blocker and use clearly labelled procedural footage ONLY for technical smoke verification, never claim it is gameplay.

No new host front end was created or changed, and no UI polish was performed. Mobile overflow correction was a functional fix.
Plaintext site password is held only in Pages secret configuration and delivered once in final report; never committed.

The backgrounds release exists but has no footage. docs/background-upload-manifest.template.json defines exact filenames, source permission statements and attribution; upload it as manifest.json only after matching clips are uploaded.
